import unittest
from unittest import mock
import c

class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_patch_helper(self):
        with mock.patch("c.helper", return_value=10):
            self.assertEqual(c.total(), 11)

    def test_patch_time(self):
        with mock.patch("time.time", return_value=5.0):
            self.assertEqual(c.stamp(), 5.0)

    def test_setattr_and_callback(self):
        c.helper = lambda: 4
        self.assertEqual(c.total(), 5)
        self.assertEqual(c.apply(lambda n: n + 1, 1), 2)

    def test_class_api(self):
        self.assertEqual(c.Counter.LIMIT, 9)
        self.assertEqual(c.Counter.zero().v, 0)
        with mock.patch.object(c.Counter, "LIMIT", 3):
            self.assertEqual(c.read_limit(), 3)

    def test_protocols(self):
        item = c.Counter(2)
        self.assertEqual(repr(item), "Counter(2)")
        with item as current:
            self.assertEqual(current.v, 2)
        item[0] = 5
        self.assertEqual(item[0], 5)

    def test_hash_must_be_an_int(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            hash(c.Bag())

    def test_builtin_base(self):
        item = c.Pocket([1, 2])
        self.assertIsInstance(item, list)
        self.assertEqual(item.width(), 3)
